name: Sit-Down Lunch Sliced Roasted Beef Sirloin with Double-Baked Potato
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's / Disney Treasure · 1923
whyItWorks: Tender carved beef sirloin and whipped double-baked potato filling make the best sit-down Embarkation/Sea-Day lunch entrée.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the thyme red-wine jus on the side, scoop the fluffy potato interior out of the skin, and skip the green beans.
watchOuts: Potato skin and green beans (leave on plate)
